enchantments.tooltip: Strength +2: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +2 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Dexterity +2: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +2 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Constitution +2: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +2 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Wisdom +2: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +2 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Intelligence +2: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +2 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.
Charisma +2: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +2 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Wizardry II: This item grants the wearer +50 maximum spell points. Sorcerers and Favored Souls gain up to double spell points from items.
